targetEdition: 1998 original studio performance on Dizzy Up the Girl

recordingBinding.recordingEdition: 1998 original studio performance on Dizzy Up the Girl
recordingBinding.notes: Performance-level binding from the original album catalog and the exact linked Apple track. The catalog dates differ by six days for the early single; both identify the 1998 original performance and original album. No ISRC or bit-identical master claim.

officialAlbumReference.retrieval: Complete Iris section in the primary artist album page indexed by web search; direct fetch returned 403. Isolated after Iris/Lyrics and before Extra Pale.
officialAlbumReference.normalization: Lowercase; remove ASCII/curly apostrophes; collapse all non-Unicode-letter-or-number runs to spaces; trim. SHA-256 over UTF-8.
officialAlbumReference.hashValidation: Root independently extracted the indexed section and reproduced the audit hash. SHA-256 implementation checked against standard empty-string and abc vectors.

selectedProviderReference.extractionValidation: Root replayed the actual GeniusProvider.extractLyrics/ChordPro pipeline against the cached source and reproduced the complete benchmark hash before comparing per-token hashes.

secondaryOfficialReference.limit: Earlier independent audit of the indexed official lyric-video text; root did not certify its performed-wording alignment. It differs from the album page.

decision: Keep full lyric accuracy unverified. The artist album page is strong written evidence, but the actual performed wording and conflicting official text need resolution; a spelling variant alone is not evidence of a wrong lyric. No saved song or live source text was overwritten.
